description: Order-specific identifier assigned to a customer for a single order
business_definition: Not the same as customer_unique_id; changes per order

description: Persistent identifier for the underlying unique customer across all their orders
business_definition: Used to track a customer across multiple purchases

description: First 5 digits of the customer's postal code
business_definition: Used for geographic and logistics analysis

description: City of the customer
business_definition: Free-text city name; standardized to lowercase in processed layer

description: Two-letter Brazilian state code of the customer
business_definition: Must match one of the 27 official Brazilian state codes

description: Unique identifier for a customer order
business_definition: Primary key of the orders table

description: Foreign key linking the order to the customer who placed it
business_definition: Must exist in customers.customer_id

description: Current lifecycle status of the order
business_definition: One of: created, approved, processing, invoiced, shipped, delivered, unavailable, canceled

description: Timestamp when the order was placed
business_definition: Anchor timestamp for all downstream delivery-timeliness calculations

description: Timestamp when payment for the order was approved
business_definition: May be null for a small number of unapproved/edge-case orders

description: Timestamp when the order was handed to the logistics carrier
business_definition: Null for orders not yet shipped or cancelled before shipment

description: Timestamp when the order was delivered to the customer
business_definition: Required for status=delivered; legitimately null for cancelled/unavailable/in-progress orders

description: Estimated delivery date communicated to the customer at purchase time
business_definition: Used to compute delivery_delay_days and is_late

description: Foreign key to the parent order
business_definition: Must exist in orders.order_id

description: Sequential line-item number within an order
business_definition: Not globally unique alone — unique only as (order_id, order_item_id)

description: Foreign key to the product sold in this line item
business_definition: Must exist in products.product_id

description: Foreign key to the seller who fulfilled this line item
business_definition: Must exist in sellers.seller_id

description: Deadline by which the seller must hand the item to the carrier
business_definition: Used for seller performance / SLA analysis

description: Sale price of the item (excludes freight)
business_definition: Must be strictly greater than 0

description: Shipping cost charged for the item
business_definition: Must be greater than or equal to 0

description: Foreign key to the paid order
business_definition: An order can have multiple payment records — not unique alone

description: Sequence number identifying multiple payment methods on a single order
business_definition: Unique only as (order_id, payment_sequential)

description: Method used to pay for the order
business_definition: e.g. credit_card, boleto, voucher, debit_card

description: Number of installments the payment was split into
business_definition: Must be greater than or equal to 1

description: Monetary value of this payment record
business_definition: Must be greater than or equal to 0

description: Unique identifier for a customer review
business_definition: Primary key of the reviews table

description: Foreign key to the reviewed order
business_definition: Must exist in orders.order_id

description: Star rating given by the customer
business_definition: Must be an integer between 1 and 5 inclusive

description: Optional free-text review title
business_definition: Optional field — null does not indicate a data quality issue

description: Optional free-text review body
business_definition: Optional field — null does not indicate a data quality issue

description: Timestamp the review survey was sent
Timestamp the customer submitted the review

description: Character length of the product description
business_definition: Descriptive attribute; legitimately missing when category is missing

description: Number of photos in the product listing
business_definition: Descriptive attribute; legitimately missing when category is missing

description: Weight of the product in grams

description: Length of the product in centimeters
business_definition: Used for freight/logistics calculations

description: Height of the product in centimeters
business_definition: Used for freight/logistics calculations

description: Width of the product in centimeters
business_definition: Used for freight/logistics calculations

description: Unique identifier for a seller
business_definition: Primary key of the sellers table

description: First 5 digits of the seller's postal code
business_definition: Used for geographic/logistics analysis

description: City of the seller
business_definition: Free-text city name; standardized to lowercase in processed layer

description: Two-letter Brazilian state code of the seller
business_definition: Must match one of the 27 official Brazilian state codes

business_definition: Grain of the raw table is observation-level; deduplicated to prefix-level for the analytical lookup

description: Latitude of the observation
Longitude of the observation
City name associated with the zip prefix
